content.title: MasTec’s (NYSE:MTZ) Q3 Sales Beat Estimates
content.summary: Infrastructure construction company MasTec (NYSE:MTZ) reported Q3 CY2025 results beating Wall Street’s revenue expectations, with sales up 22% year on year to $3.97 billion. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $14.08 billion at the midpoint came in 0.6% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.48 per share was 7.7% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
